title: epiphyllum × bauericardium
intro: Epiphyllum × bauericardium, commonly known as the "Queen of the Night" cactus or Night-Blooming Cereus, is a hybrid cactus species that belongs to the Epiphyllum genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Epiphyllum × bauericardium are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities. However, more research is needed to confirm the exact health benefits and bioactive constituents of this plant.
